title: Great app, minimalistic
body:
I installed a bunch of habit trackers to see which one i liked the most. This one won by far because it’s free and its ease of use/simplicity. It’s very aesthetically pleasing and the little vibration when you check off a habit is so satisfying. only 2 improvement suggestions:
1. I really wish i could change the colour of the habits after they’ve been created. I hate that if i want to change the colour, I have to delete and create the habit again which loses all progress
2. I would love if there was a larger widget that displays more than one hair on my home screen, that would be amazing!

author: juxtaglomerulus apparatus

title: Everything I’m looking for in a productivity app
body: I don’t usually write reviews but I recently downloaded a bunch of habit tracker apps with most of their features frustratingly being behind a paywall. Then I found Onrise which has a habit tracker, journal and focus timer all for free. I love the way I can track multiple habits, see my streak and use the timer on achieving my habits throughout the day. Honestly an amazing app, this is my number 1 productivity app and I plan to continue using it for a very long time! Thank you so much for developing such a fantastic app!
author: turquoise888

title: Amazing app
body: This app is amazing and I love that it’s free, I myself have adhd and can’t focus or remember what to do and when, before having this app I’d wind up on Sunday night at 2:00 in the morning doing washing for school the next day, but with this app I get notifications when I need to get things done and the colours of the tasks keep me interested so pretty, but the fact there is a journal and a focus function help so much and it’s amazing how much I get done with the focus function 100% Recommend🩷
author: black_friesian

title: Great but a couple tips
body: The design language is great, however sometimes the app and its ui feel overcomplicated. It would be nice if there was a "quick" way to create tasks without reminder and time selection. Also, the app icon is discouraging and doesn't really fit with the theme of the app. Something lighter and maybe more colourful would attract more people and create a better experience!
author: SerialReviewer2

title: Keeper
body: Been through many apps. Not that I really did them any justice, since good tools don’t work with a bad user (like me). This one is simple, beautiful, and I love how the Podomoro timer has pause (the last one I used didn’t - just start and stop). I am a sucker for clean UI, so that’s one bias. No up front cost but  I would so pay a once-off for this.
author: Steam Bun Invasion

title: Almost perfect!!
body:
I really love the simplicity of the app. The combination of habit tracker, Pomodoro timer, and journal is great because it’s unlikely I will get distracted by something else within the app.

My only two suggestions would be to have a few more options for widgets, and the option to show more habits at once within the app. A widget that could display more than one habit (5 or more) would be great so I can be reminded of my habits as soon as I open my phone (notifications are more distracting than helpful for me). And an option within the app to have a more compact view of all habits, for the same reasons.

I would probably describe this app as perfect if those changes were made. I’ll continue using it regardless, it’s great!
author: B Mere

title: Seriously amazing app
body: This is the first time I’m writing a review on the app store. Because this app is seriously amazing. The reason it’s so great is because it does few things and does them well. It has only 3 functions - a habit tracker, a journal, and a focus timer. All 3 are built with the greatest simplicity. So far I’ve only used the habit tracker and it’s exactly what it should be. Simple, intuitive, and pleasing to the senses. This app is an example of what a good app should be - no nonsense, only what serves the user
